record.question: The full form of the abbreviation ICANN is?
options: Internet Corporation for Assigned Numbers and Names
Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers
International Corporation for Assigned Number and Names
International Council for Assigned Names and Numbers
record.explanation: Answer B: Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers. ICANN stands for Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers. Reference: https://www.icann.org/resources/pages/welcome-2012-02-25-en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
